body:
Running `/fix --update-all-dependencies` previously omitted upstream-reporting instructions because they were treated as already supplied by `--deep-analysis`. This change includes them in the generated issue and enables dependency reporting in every solver tool by default during dependency updates.

`--report-dependencies-issues` can also enable reporting independently. `--no-report-dependencies-issues` and explicit false values disable it, including through `/fix`, `/hive`, and Telegram `/task` handoffs. Reports cover general logic, duplicated code, missing features, and bugs requiring workarounds; necessary local workarounds may remain so upstream fixes do not block the pull request.

The implementation shares one reporting paragraph and resolves the omitted/true/false states without overriding explicit opt-outs. It includes documentation in all four supported languages, an offline preview example, a minor-release Changeset, and a [case study with the complete requirements, research, alternatives, and regression evidence](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/tree/issue-2751-3b566158eaa0/docs/case-studies/issue-2751).

The first fresh CI run [failed the dependency freshness gate](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37759757893): Box `2.10.3` had been released, leaving three `2.10.2` Docker base pins stale. The follow-up updates those pins, current task-image metadata, verification-script defaults, and existing pin/runtime tests. The case study preserves the failure log, upstream release comparison, failing pin regression, and passing checks after the refresh.

To reproduce the original bug at base commit `c2089953`, run `/fix` with `--update-all-dependencies --dry-run`: the generated issue omits upstream-reporting instructions. The initial regression run, preserved in the case study, records 10 failures before the fix. Verify the resulting behavior without creating an issue or starting a solver:

```sh
node --test tests/report-dependencies-issues.test.mjs
node examples/dependency-reporting-preview.mjs
node examples/dependency-reporting-preview.mjs --no-report-dependencies-issues
node src/fix.mjs link-assistant/hive-mind --update-all-dependencies --dry-run
node src/fix.mjs link-assistant/hive-mind --update-all-dependencies --no-report-dependencies-issues --dry-run
```

Validation:

- 13 regression tests pass, covering all six solver tools, solve/hive parsing, generated issue bodies, mocked issue creation, CLI passthrough, and Telegram handoffs; the related dependency-update and Telegram suites pass 52 and 28 tests.
- All 579 default test files pass (`node scripts/run-tests.mjs --suite default --continue-on-failure`); the complete compressed log is committed in the case study.
- ESLint, Prettier, duplication, secret scanning, syntax, line limits, documentation validation, and documentation language synchronization pass.
- All five affected Docker/image test files pass after the Box refresh (including 52 runtime and 22 task-language assertions).
- Changeset and version checks pass; all 168 tracked dependency declarations are current. The latest default branch is merged into this branch.

- Fresh CI on `a61016f6` passes: [Checks and release](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37762993635), [Security](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37762993269), and [Broken Link Checker](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37762993129). Docker builds, running-container verification, the default suite, and GitHub integration tests pass.

Fixes #2751.
title: Enable upstream dependency reporting during dependency updates
